about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Data Science Specialist with Full-Stack Expertise
about.content1: I am a 2nd-year Master's student in Data Science & Big Data, specializing in the Data Science track with focus on Deep Learning, Generative AI, and advanced machine learning techniques.
about.content2: My academic journey has equipped me with comprehensive expertise across the data spectrum—from statistical analysis and machine learning to big data technologies and cloud infrastructure. I've hands-on experience with Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and distributed systems.
about.content3: Through 15+ diverse projects, I've developed practical skills in building end-to-end AI solutions, from data collection and processing to model deployment and web application development.

experiences.description: Designed and implemented data-driven solutions for retail expansion strategy using geospatial analysis and machine learning.

Developed a capacity-constrained clustering algorithm integrating demographic and geographic data to balance zones by store count and population
Collected, cleaned, and analyzed large-scale geospatial datasets using Python, pandas, geopandas, and scikit-learn
Created predictive models and interactive Folium maps to support strategic retail expansion decisions
